svg.title: From paper sources to published explanations
svg.desc: Three workflows verify their own sources, share analysis and writing, review generated pages, then push, deploy and verify them. Daily image generation is waived; original paper figures remain checked.
svg.text: From paper sources to published explanations
Arrows carry content and source records
1 Verify the actual sources
Daily: official text and PDFs of selected papers
Conference: official identity, metadata and PDF
Historical: fixed page scope, then original papers
Source credentials stay specific to each workflow
Content + identity
2 Shared analysis and writing
Keep analysis, assessment, tags and explanations
Check tables, equations and figures against sources
Verified results
3 Generate and independently review pages
Read final files; review text, figures and sources
Bind review records to page bytes and blog commits
Receipt-authorized changes
4 Push, deploy and verify the web pages
Verify the remote commit and its deployment
Check every URL, HTTP 200 response and title
Save verification before reporting the site live
Daily: no generated images; original figures remain.
Each operation retains its own required checks.
